sources.title: GitHub - PierreMarieCurie/rf-detr-onnx: ONNX model with inference ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains code to load an ONNX version of RF-DETR and perform inference, including drawing the results on images. It demonstrates how to convert a PyTorch model to ONNX format and inference with minimal dependencies. RF-DETR is a transformer-based object detection and instance segmentation architecture developed by Roboflow.

sources.title: tuxracer/coco-rfdetr-small · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An RF-DETR Small model that detects the 80 COCO categories, exported to ONNX. Small and fast enough for realtime inference on a phone or in the browser on WebGPU. Built for dashradar.app. The weights are Roboflow's COCO checkpoint and nothing is trained here, so what this repo adds is the export and the contract around it. The architecture is described in arXiv:2511.09554.

sources.title: AnnotateIt/rtdetr-r50vd-coco-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The unchanged graph was compared with official PyTorch checkpoint revision df939e661d8c52e80608d1ec566561aabd25a4e7 on a real COCO image. PyTorch and ONNX produced the same five detections at threshold 0.3, with matching classes, scores, and boxes. The graph ran successfully through AnnotateIt's onnxruntime-web 1.24.3 WASM runtime.
